subject: Repackaging committed use + reseller netting — evidence & margin split
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Gina Lopez <gina.lopez@cloudhaven.com>, CloudHaven Procurement <procurement@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Repackaging committed use + reseller netting — evidence & margin split

Gina — great to connect yesterday. Following up with a concrete proposal for the Private Offer structure we discussed for CloudHaven's committed-use migration: 

Summary (proposal):
- Consolidate three metered SKUs into a single committed SKU with tiered volume discounts (0-100k / 100k-500k / 500k+ tokens-day equivalent).
- Apply a fixed reseller uplift (BluePeak) of 6% on net revenue, with a deferred brokerage fee (1.5%) that is netted against first-quarter usage true-up.
- Passback / crediting: any overage credits for the initial 12 months to be routed through Redwood to CloudHaven; reseller receives documentation for margin reconciliation.

We need two things from your team to finalize legal and partner ops: 
1) Procurement confirmation of the target commit and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly).
2) Evidence for reseller carveout — CloudHaven will need a short attestation from BluePeak showing their channel agreement and tax ID for invoicing.

I've attached a draft pricing summary and a reseller margin workback (Excel). Ben (cc'd) is on the revenue-ops side and will verify flows. Proposed next step: 30-min call Thu to align on doc updates and signoff timeline.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudHaven_POC_pricing_v1.pdf, reseller-margin-workback.xlsx

From: Gina Lopez <gina.lopez@cloudhaven.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudHaven Procurement <procurement@cloudhaven.com>, BluePeak Partners <partners@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 13:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Repackaging committed use + reseller netting — evidence & margin split

Thanks Mina — the summary is helpful. A few clarifying questions from procurement and finance: 

- On the 6% reseller uplift: can you show gross vs net AR flow? Procurement wants to understand whether the 6% is applied pre-credit or post-credit.
- The deferred 1.5% brokerage fee — we need to see the mechanics of the true-up (which ledger line gets debited).
- For BluePeak evidence: BluePeak has asked for a clause that the reseller uplift is fixed for the first 12 months and then renegotiable with 60 days notice. Is that acceptable to Redwood?

We can do Thu 11am PT for the call. I've looped BluePeak (cc) — BluePeak, please confirm you can provide the channel attestation and the MAP PDF.

Best,
Gina Lopez
Head of Infrastructure Procurement
CloudHaven

Attachment: MAP-doc-BluePeak.pdf (BluePeak included to confirm)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Repackaging committed use + reseller netting — evidence & margin split

Looping in Irene for legal/partner ops detail. Notes for the call: 
- We should prepare a simple waterfall model (gross customer charge -> Redwood list -> reseller uplift -> deferred brokerage true-up -> net revenue to Redwood). I'll attach a pivot-friendly tab in the workbook for Thursday.
- On the 6%: ops prefers to apply it on gross invoice before applied credits (simpler for tax/invoice routing). If procurement pushes back, we can present both scenarios with P&L impact.
- On the 60-day renegotiation clause: acceptable but prefer an explicit floor during the initial committed term (e.g., cannot reduce uplift below 4% in year 1).

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--Forwarded message attached--

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Gina Lopez <gina.lopez@cloudhaven.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: BluePeak Partners <partners@bluepeak.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Repackaging committed use + reseller netting — evidence & margin split

Gina / team — quick legal/ops confirmation ahead of Thu: 
- We can implement the uplift on gross invoice and show a line item for "Reseller fee (6%)". Credits (e.g., promotional credits or overage mitigation) will be applied after uplift for clarity on partner compensation.
- For the deferred brokerage: propose a quarterly true-up process with a single credit memo to BluePeak; ledger will be a contra-revenue flow into "Channel adjustments" so finance has visibility.
- Contract language: 60-day notice to renegotiate uplift is acceptable. We will include a Year-1 floor clause set at 4% uplift to protect partner economics. 

I'll bring a redline of two short clauses (billing waterfall + uplift floor) to the call.

Irene Choi
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Gina Lopez <gina.lopez@cloudhaven.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: BluePeak Partners <partners@bluepeak.com>, CloudHaven Procurement <procurement@cloudhaven.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Repackaging committed use + reseller netting — evidence & margin split

Thanks everyone — call went well. Action items and agreed scope: 

1) Redwood to share two scenarios by EOD Mon: (A) uplift applied pre-credit (gross) and (B) uplift applied post-credit (net). Include P&L delta and invoice examples for both. (Owner: Ben)
2) BluePeak to provide channel attestation + MAP doc and tax ID before we finalize PO. (Owner: BluePeak)
3) Redwood legal (Irene) to circulate short redline with uplift floor (4% Year-1) and quarterly true-up language. (Owner: Irene)
4) CloudHaven procurement to indicate preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) by next Wed.

Please confirm timelines or flag blockers. If all good, we'll aim to have a signed PO + partner attestation by end of next week and intake the Private Offer into marketplace ops for execution.

Regards,
Gina
Gina Lopez
Head of Infrastructure Procurement
CloudHaven
